label: Grandchild in trouble
text: Grandma it's me, I was in a car accident and I'm in jail. I need $2,500 for bail right now. Please don't tell Mom and Dad, they'll be so mad. My lawyer will tell you how to send it. Please hurry.

label: Medicare card
text: MEDICARE NOTICE: Your Medicare card will be suspended today. To get your new card, verify your Medicare number and Social Security number at http://medicare-renew.info/card within 24 hours.

label: IRS tax threat
text: This is the IRS. You owe $3,812 in back taxes. A warrant for your arrest has been issued. To avoid arrest, pay today with Target gift cards and call Officer Daniels at 202-555-0147. Final notice.

label: Boss wants gift cards
text: Hi, it's Pastor Mike. I'm in a meeting and can't talk. I need you to buy four $200 Google Play gift cards for the church and send me photos of the back. Keep this between us for now, it's a surprise.

label: Computer virus pop-up
text: WARNING! Your computer has been infected with a virus. Your bank information is at risk. Do not turn off your computer. Call Microsoft Support immediately at 1-888-555-0199 so a technician can fix it with remote access.

label: Online sweetheart
text: My darling, I miss you so much. I am stuck overseas and they won't let me leave until I pay a customs fee of $1,800. Can you send it by Western Union? Then I can buy my plane ticket and finally hold you.

label: Package delivery
text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Update your details within 48 hours or it will be returned: https://usps-redelivery.top/track

label: Bank alert
text: Chase Alert: Unusual sign-in on your account. Your account has been suspended. Verify your identity now at https://chase-secure-login.xyz and enter your account number and PIN.

label: You won a prize
text: Congratulations! You've won $850,000 in the Publishers National Sweepstakes! To claim your prize, pay a $499 processing fee by wire transfer today.

label: Crypto investment
text: Hi friend, my uncle's bitcoin program gives guaranteed returns of 40% every month. It's risk-free. Send $1,000 in crypto to this wallet and double your money by Friday.

label: Pharmacy reminder (real)
text: Walgreens: Your prescription is ready for pickup at your Main St store. Reply STOP to opt out.

label: Text from daughter (real)
text: Hi Mom, I'll pick you up at 10 tomorrow for your doctor's appointment. Want to get lunch after? Love you.
